main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads N integers, sorts them, constructs two alternating center-out arrangements B and C, and prints the larger of their total adjacent absolute differences, with a direct absolute-difference answer when N is exactly 2." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read an integer from stdin into N using scanf. RESULT N]
            [COMMAND Declare array A of size 100000 and read N integers into A[0] through A[N-1] using a for loop with i starting at 0 and continuing while i < N. RESULT A]
            [COMMAND If N is exactly 2, print abs(A[0] - A[1]) followed by a newline and return 0; otherwise continue. RESULT N_is_2]
            [COMMAND Sort array A in place using qsort on N elements with element size sizeof(A[0]) and comparator int_sort. RESULT A]
            [COMMAND Declare array B of size 100000 and integer variables pos, beg, end, flag, offset; set pos = N / 2, B[pos] = A[0], beg = 1, end = N - 1, flag = 1, and offset = 1. RESULT B]
            [COMMAND Fill B from A alternating around the center: while true, if flag == 1, assign B[pos-offset] = A[end--], if end < beg break, assign B[pos+offset] = A[end--], if end < beg break, then set flag = 0; otherwise assign B[pos-offset] = A[beg++], if end < beg break, assign B[pos+offset] = A[beg++], if end < beg break, then set flag = 1; after a complete iteration increment offset. RESULT B]
            [COMMAND Declare array C of size 100000; set C[pos] = A[N-1], beg = 0, end = N - 2, flag = 0, and offset = 1. RESULT C]
            [COMMAND Fill C from A alternating around the center: while true, if flag == 1, assign C[pos-offset] = A[end--], if end < beg break, assign C[pos+offset] = A[end--], if end < beg break, then set flag = 0; otherwise assign C[pos-offset] = A[beg++], if end < beg break, assign C[pos+offset] = A[beg++], if end < beg break, then set flag = 1; after a complete iteration increment offset. RESULT C]
            [COMMAND Initialize long long int sumB = 0; for i starting at 1 and continuing while i < N, add abs(B[i-1] - B[i]) to sumB. RESULT sumB]
            [COMMAND Initialize long long int sumC = 0; for i starting at 1 and continuing while i < N, add abs(C[i-1] - C[i]) to sumC. RESULT sumC]
            [COMMAND If sumB < sumC, print sumC followed by a newline; otherwise print sumB followed by a newline; then return 0. RESULT stdout]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
